references.text: Samson's earlier lie to Delilah that he would become weak if bound with seven fresh bowstrings. The same pattern of lying about the source of his strength.
Samson's third lie to Delilah, where he continues to mislead her about the secret behind his strength.
A previous event where Samson was bound with new ropes but broke free when the Spirit of the Lord came upon him.
The true revelation of Samson's strength—his hair as a Nazirite—in contrast to the lies in verses 7, 11, and 13.
